_note: What you see: Administration, people: members and their vault status, team offboarding, revoke and restore suites, set up account recovery.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Beheer, personen: leden en hun kluisstatus, team-offboarding, suites intrekken en herstellen, accountherstel instellen.
gedelegeerd aan de groep Personeelszaken: delegated to the HR ICT group
Zie welke gebruikers een kluis hebben in: See which users have set up a vault. Start offboarding or revoke a suite from a row.
Trek de teammaptoegang van een vertrekke: Revoke a leaving employee's team folder access and hand their team secrets over to a successor.
Gebruiker verwijderd uit 3 teammappen. 1: User removed from 3 team folders. 12 team secrets handed over to Anouk Bakker.
De gebruiker zit nog in groep Applicatie: The user is still in the Application management group, which is a member of a team folder. Remove the user from the group or disable the account.
Trek de suite van een gebruiker of appli: Force-revoke a user's or application's suite when the owner cannot (forgotten master password, departure or compromise), or restore a revoked suite. You confirm your own password first.
Typ de suite-ID nogmaals ter bevestiging: Type the suite ID again to confirm
Behandel de geheimen van de suite als ge: Treat the suite's secrets as compromised (flag for rotation and warn owners)
Deze gebruiker is aangemeld voor account: This user is enrolled in account recovery. Restoring keeps the secrets; revoking removes the enrolment.
Intrekken verwijdert ook de noodtoegangs: Revoking also removes the suite's emergency access contacts. A suite revoked as compromised cannot be restored.
Laat gebruikers die hun hoofdwachtwoord: Let users who forgot their master password get their vault back, approved by recovery officers you appoint.
Publiceer deze vingerafdruk intern, zoda: Publish this fingerprint internally, so users can check it before they enrol.
